issues.issue: Whether the RPD erred in finding her conversion testimony hesitant and contradictory and in ignoring her explanations and documents
issues.applicant_position: RPD wrongly found her conversion testimony hesitant and contradictory; it ignored her explanations and documents.
issues.respondent_position: Minister did not intervene on appeal.
issues.result_quote: For these reasons, I am of the opinion that the RPD committed determinative errors by failing to make any reference to or provide an analysis of certain explanations

issues.issue: Whether the RPD erred in treating the failure to seek asylum on earlier trips as inconsistent behaviour
issues.applicant_position: Not seeking asylum on earlier trips is not inconsistent behaviour; the RPD finding is wrong.
issues.respondent_position: Minister did not intervene on appeal.
issues.result_quote: the appellant cannot be faulted for not seeking asylum when the alleged reasons for her leaving her country had not even materialized yet

issues.issue: Whether the RPD erred on the country documents (divorced women living alone) and the other arguments
issues.applicant_position: RPD was selective on country evidence and speculated about the mother's failure to intervene.
issues.respondent_position: Minister did not intervene on appeal.
issues.result_quote: it is not necessary for me to assess the other points the appellant's lawyer raised.

issues.issue: Remedy: whether the RAD should decide the claim or refer it to a differently constituted RPD panel
issues.applicant_position: Asks that the RAD allow the appeal.
issues.respondent_position: Minister did not intervene on appeal.
issues.result_quote: the RAD sets aside the RPD's determination and refers the matter to a differently constituted RPD panel for re-determination of the refugee protection claim.
